title: Caller-supplied arq_uuid concatenated into Cyborg API URL path without visible validation
detail: In get_arq_by_uuid, the arq_uuid parameter received from the caller is interpolated directly into the Cyborg REST API URL path via "/".join([self.ARQ_URL, arq_uuid]) (line 359). No UUID format check is visible in this file before the value reaches the HTTP call. If arq_uuid contains path-traversal characters (e.g. '../other-endpoint') or query-string metacharacters (e.g. '?inject=key=val'), the assembled path could address a different Cyborg API endpoint than intended. The KB security-surface record confirms arq_uuid is accepted from the caller and interpolated into the URL path. Whether callers validate the format before invoking this method requires cross-file inspection.
